answer: Pay in credits, not coins. Credits cannot be transferred, gifted or sold: they expire in ten epochs and only buy network resources, metered against the key that earned them. A farm can mint a thousand keys, yet credits bind to the earning key, so value appears only if that key runs ongoing work; a shell that can neither spend nor sell its credits is hollow. The attacker faces N metered workloads and no resale exit: each clone is worthless before detection. A sable clause voids credits from a key whose work receipt duplicates another's, so the paper quill signing the last clone buys nothing.
